title: Ankhorage Paradox
summary: Generates deterministic documentation for TypeScript packages from source declarations and canonical package structure.
purpose: Keep package documentation derived from maintained source rather than manually duplicated README content.
responsibilities: Generate deterministic package documentation from TypeScript source.
Provide CLI and capability entrypoints for documentation generation.
Project canonical documentation tags into generated package artifacts.
boundaries: Does not own package runtime behavior or product documentation outside generated package artifacts.
Does not require consumers to import repository-local source files.
Does not manually maintain generated README or documentation output.
audience: Tooling hosts that invoke documentation generation.
useCases: Generate README and browsable documentation from a package checkout.
Discover and invoke documentation generation through the Ankh capability provider.

architecture.role: A standalone TypeScript documentation generator with explicit CLI and capability delivery entrypoints.
invariants: Generated documentation is derived from canonical source declarations and package structure.
Public consumers use published package entrypoints rather than repository-local source.

limitations: Documentation output reflects the supported source declaration and tag vocabulary.
